thread.title: Apple adds 30 points to Dow after report that Buffett bought 75 million shares - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Apple adds 30 points to Dow after report that Buffett bought 75 million shares - MarketWatch
text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average slashed an opening 150-point drop to trade sharply higher Friday afternoon, on the back of a pop in Apple Inc. AAPL, +3.92% Shares of Apple were contributing about 50 points to the price-weighted Dow DJIA, +1.39% after a report from CNBC late Thursday said Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway Inc. BRK.A, +2.28% BRK.B, +2.16% acquired some 75 million additional shares of the iPhone maker during the first quarter. Shares of Apple were up about 4%, or $7, contributing about 48 points to the Dow, with a $1 move in any one of the blue-chip gauge's 30 components equating to a 6.89-point swing. The Dow was recently up 365 points, or 1.5%, at 24,296. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 index SPX, +1.28% was up about 1.4% at 2,667, while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +1.71% was advancing by 1.8% at 7,217. Apple is the largest company by market value and tends to have an outsize influence on market-value weighted indexes like the Nasdaq and S&P 500.
